# Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("All logp inputs must be numpy arrays")
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Each logp matrix must be 2D")
        if 0 in arr.shape:
            raise ValueError("Matrices must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("All logp values must be finite")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("All logp values must be nonpositive")
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All logp matrices must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")

    n_candidates, horizon = shape
    # Compute normalized decreasing weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    if weight_sum == 0:
        norm_weights = raw_weights
    else:
        norm_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Compute weighted future‑token losses
    loss_with = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no, loss_call)
    L_plus = loss_with
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    return keep, margin
